description: The autonomy.denied event (S56 T6, R5): published after a veto is committed. A veto is authority REMOVED — it overrides every allow on the component and its root — so its event matters as much as a grant's: a pinned loop about to act will be denied at the next action, and a subscribed panel should say so without polling autonomy.list. The payload is ids only, and the event is filed under the node's workspace root like the grant's.
